purpose: Generate JLPT N1 and AP daily study from a stable long-term curriculum instead of ad-hoc questions.

generation_gate.before_start: Do not create new daily study JSON, SQL, daily-index entries, or consume JLPT words before the start date. Reply that daily study starts on 2026-09-07.
generation_gate.historical_exception: Keep the already completed 2026-08-31 and 2026-09-01 history entries, but do not generate any additional prestart dates.

sources_of_truth.runtime_learning_state: Remote D1: actual progress, wrong answers, review due dates, mastery states

mandatory_pre_generation_read_order: Remote D1 learning state when available
daily_generation_priority: 1. overdue review and unresolved wrong answers
2. weak topics according to recent accuracy/mastery
3. new curriculum content due in the current phase
6. balanced coverage of topics not recently seen

read_before_generating: previous daily data files for at least 90 days where available
history_rules.repeat_rule: Repeated content must be explicitly classified as review and should use a changed context or question stem unless memorization itself is the goal.

adaptation_rules.accuracy_below_60: reduce new content by about 25% next session and increase direct review/wrong-answer work
adaptation_rules.accuracy_60_to_79: keep normal new-content volume and add one focused review block
adaptation_rules.accuracy_80_or_above: keep normal volume and advance to the next planned curriculum topic
adaptation_rules.three_consecutive_wrong_same_topic: mark topic as high priority and require a concept re-teach before more advanced questions
adaptation_rules.overdue_review_over_daily_capacity: review takes priority; new content may be reduced but not silently discarded from the curriculum
adaptation_rules.missed_day: do not double the next day's load; roll overdue review forward and keep the planned new-content backlog visible

weekly_cycle.day_7: cumulative review/test using content from the previous 7 study days
weekly_test_should_include: representative questions from newly learned content

monthly_cycle.action: larger cumulative test plus curriculum coverage audit

daily_output_contract.registration_goal: After git pull, the user should be able to register that day's learning data by applying only daily-study-migrations/YYYY-MM-DD.sql.

execution_rule: The daily-generation-spec is authoritative for exact daily lesson order, question counts, output paths, anti-repetition behavior, SQL generation, and chat delivery.
